- Education (3): Early Childhood; Health and Physical Education; Special Education.
- Engineering (8): Aerospace Engineering; Architectural Engineering; Chemical Engineering; Civil Engineering; Communication Engineering; Electrical Engineering; Mechanical Engineering; Petroleum Engineering.
- Humanities and Social Sciences (13): Arabic Language and Literature; English Literature; Geography; History and Archaeology; Linguistics; Mass Communication; Political Science; Psychology; Tourism Studies; Translation Studies; Visual Studies and Creative Industries; Applied Sociology and Social Data Analytics; Social Work.
- Law (1): Law.
- Medicine and Health Sciences (4): Dietetics; Nutritional Science; Speech-Language Pathology; Doctor of Medicine.
